name: Ganteng-Ganteng Genteng: Kontes Otot Paling Viral
original_name: Ganteng-Ganteng Genteng: Kontes Otot Paling Viral
overview: Frozen out of the family business, a spoiled heir named Joni sets out to prove himself by returning to his hometown to sell his family’s nearly-collapsing roof-tile factory. Desperate to grab attention (and jack up the land price), Joni comes up with a completely unhinged idea: a muscle-flexing contest for the factory workers.
